facts.value: Students must earn a minimum of 24 credits during the yearly fall/spring review period.

facts.value: Students may not use the following credit for meeting the minimum 24 credit hours requirement: Summer sessions and consortium agreement classes, repeated classes, incomplete grades or audited classes. Any credits received by examination, including AP, CLEP, IB and other tests.
